notes.title: Scaling down
notes.content:
This update scales down the game to its original size. Yes, it is much shorter now, but I believe it is better this way, for now at least. I thought I could scale up this project, but that was too much for me. All additional locations (except the Jurba boss fight) are still available after the main game through the Limbo section in the main menu.  

Bug fixes and changes:
[list]
[*]New section in the main menu available after the first playthrough
[*]2 new endings
[*] Wheeller respawn rate in the Car scene is 3 times longer
[*]Shotgun ammo is now working 100% of the time
[*]The wall, blocking the exit from a room in Waterpark, was removed
[*]Enemies do not respawn upon loading from the save
[*]Jurba bossfight removed
[*]Other minor changes
[/list]
